NlsAlgorithm#summary.en: Algorithm used to fit a nonlinear least-squares model.

NlsAnovaResult.table.Df#summary.en: Difference in residual degrees of freedom for each comparison.

NlsAnovaResult.table.Pr(>F)#summary.en: Upper-tail F-test probability for each comparison.

NlsAnovaResult.table.Res.Df#summary.en: Residual degrees of freedom for each model.

NlsAnovaResult.table.Res.Sum Sq#summary.en: Residual sum of squares for each model.

NlsAnovaResult.table.Sum Sq#summary.en: Difference in residual sum of squares for each comparison.

NlsConfintOptions.level#summary.en: Confidence level between zero and one.

NlsConfintOptions.parm#summary.en: Parameter names for which to compute intervals; omitted means all estimable parameters.

NlsConfintResult.values#summary.en: Lower and upper confidence limits, one pair per parameter.

NlsConfintResult.warnings#summary.en: Warnings produced while computing the intervals.

NlsControl#summary.en: Convergence controls for nonlinear least squares.

NlsControl.minFactor#summary.en: Minimum step-length factor used by the line search.

NlsControl.scaleOffset#summary.en: Positive offset used in the convergence scaling criterion.

NlsControl.warnOnly#summary.en: Whether non-convergence is reported as a warning instead of an error.

NlsModel.converged#summary.en: Whether the convergence criterion was met.

NlsModel.data#summary.en: Numeric data columns retained for prediction and profiling.

NlsModel.exactFit#summary.en: Whether the residual sum of squares is exactly zero.

NlsModel.nobs#summary.en: Number of observations used in fitting.

NlsModel.rows#summary.en: Original row indices retained after missing-value handling.

NlsOptions.lower#summary.en: Lower parameter bounds for the bounded algorithm.

NlsOptions.upper#summary.en: Upper parameter bounds for the bounded algorithm.

NlsOptions.weights#summary.en: Non-negative observation weights, or the name of a data column.

NlsPredictOptions.newdata#summary.en: New data columns at which to evaluate the fitted expression.

NlsSummaryResult.coefficients#summary.en: Coefficient table with estimates, standard errors and test statistics.

NlsSummaryResult.coefficients.values#sum.en: Rows of coefficient estimates, standard errors and test statistics.

NlsSummaryResult.df#summary.en: Residual and model degrees of freedom.

NlsSummaryResult.nobs#summary.en: Number of observations used in fitting.

NlsSummaryResult.warnings#summary.en: Warnings produced while computing the summary.

PolrAnovaResult#summary.en: Result table from sequential likelihood-ratio comparisons of nested ordinal-regression fits.

PolrAnovaResult.rows#summary.en: Model or term labels associated with the comparison.

PolrAnovaResult.table. Df#summary.en: Degrees of freedom for each likelihood-ratio test.

PolrAnovaResult.table.Model#summary.en: Formula or term label for each fitted model.

PolrAnovaResult.table.Pr(Chi)#summary.en: Chi-squared tail probability for each comparison.

PolrAnovaResult.table.Resid. df#summary.en: Residual degrees of freedom for each model.

PolrAnovaResult.table.Test#summary.en: Label of each sequential model comparison.

PolrConfintOptions.parm#summary.en: Slope names or 1-based slope positions. Omitted means all slopes.

PolrConfintResult.values#summary.en: Confidence limits, one pair per parameter.

PolrConfintResult.warnings#summary.en: Warnings produced while computing the intervals.

PolrMethod#summary.en: Name of the cumulative distribution used by an ordinal regression.

PolrModel#summary.en: Stored formula, design metadata and observations needed by prediction and model comparison.

PolrModel.externalOffset#summary.en: Whether the offset was supplied separately from the formula.

PolrModel.factorLevels#summary.en: Observed or declared levels for categorical predictors.

PolrModel.offsetColumn#summary.en: Name of the data column used as an offset, when supplied by name.

PolrModel.predictorVariables#summary.en: Predictor variable names in model-matrix order.

PolrModel.rawHessian#summary.en: Observed Hessian in internal parameter coordinates.

PolrModel.rows#summary.en: Original row indices retained after missing-value handling.

PolrModel.y#summary.en: Response values encoded as ordered category indices.

PolrOptions.offset#summary.en: Offset added to the linear predictor.

PolrOptions.start#summary.en: Initial slopes followed by the ordered cut-points.

PolrOptions.weights#summary.en: Non-negative prior weights, or the name of a data column.

PolrPredictOptions.newdata#summary.en: New predictor columns; omitted to return predictions for the fitted observations.

PolrPredictOptions.rowNames#summary.en: Row labels for a new data frame (default: "1", "2", ...).

PolrPredictOptions.type#summary.en: Return the most likely category (default) or the category probabilities.

PolrPredictProbs#summary.en: Probability matrix returned when {@link PolrPredictOptions.type} is "probs".

PolrPredictProbs.values#summary.en: Predicted category probabilities; null marks an unavailable value.

PolrPredictResult#summary.en: Predicted categories, or a probability matrix when type is "probs".

PolrResult#summary.en: Result of {@link polr}: cumulative-link estimates and their observed-information covariance.

PolrResult.coefficients#summary.en: Named slope estimates, excluding the cut-points.

PolrResult.edf#summary.en: Number of estimated slopes and cut-points.

PolrResult.fittedValues#summary.en: Fitted category probabilities, one row per retained observation.

PolrResult.model#summary.en: Data and numerical state retained for the companion methods.

PolrResult.nobs#summary.en: Sum of the positive case weights.

PolrResult.zeta#summary.en: Named ordered cut-points, separately from the slopes.

PolrSummaryResult#summary.en: Table of slope and cut-point estimates, standard errors and Wald statistics.

PolrSummaryResult.values#summary.en: Rows of estimates, standard errors and test statistics.

PolrSummaryResult.warnings#summary.en: Warnings produced while computing the summary.

PolrVcovResult#summary.en: Covariance matrix of the slope and cut-point estimates in coefficient order.

PolrVcovResult.columns#summary.en: Parameter names in matrix column order.

PolrVcovResult.rows#summary.en: Parameter names in matrix row order.

PolrVcovResult.warnings#summary.en: Warnings produced while computing the covariance.

PsiInput#summary.en: Scalar or vector input accepted by the robust score functions.

PsiOutput#summary.en: Scalar output returned by a robust score function.

PsiResult#summary.en: Scalar or vector output returned by the robust score functions.

RlmModel#summary.en: Data and settings retained by an M fit.

RlmModel.c#summary.en: Hampel rejection point or bisquare tuning constant.

RlmModel.rows#summary.en: Original row indices retained after missing-value handling.

RlmOptions.acc#summary.en: Dimensionless estimating-equation and scale fixed-point tolerance. Default 1e-10.

RlmOptions.c#summary.en: Hampel rejection point or bisquare tuning constant. Default 8 or 4.685.

RlmOptions.init#summary.en: Least-squares start, deterministic LTS start, or initial coefficients. Default "ls".

RlmOptions.maxit#summary.en: Maximum number of IRLS iterations. Default 1000, allowing the estimating equations to reach their solution.

RlmOptions.method#summary.en: Estimation method. "MM" uses a deterministic S start and a fixed-scale redescending M step. Default "M".

RlmOptions.scaleEst#summary.en: Scale estimator. "Huber" and "proposal 2" are equivalent. Default "MAD".

RlmOptions.weights#summary.en: Non-negative observation weights, or a column name.

RlmOptions.wtMethod#summary.en: Meaning of weights. "inv" uses inverse-variance weights; "case" uses frequency weights.

RlmPsi#summary.en: The score function used by robust regression.

RlmPsiBisquareOptions#summary.en: Options for the bisquare psi function.

RlmPsiBisquareOptions.deriv#summary.en: Return the derivative of psi instead of psi(u)/u. Default 0.

RlmPsiHampelOptions#summary.en: Options for the Hampel psi function.

RlmPsiHampelOptions.deriv#summary.en: Return the derivative of psi instead of psi(u)/u. Default 0.

RlmPsiHuberOptions#summary.en: Options shared by the psi functions.

RlmPsiHuberOptions.deriv#summary.en: Return the derivative of psi instead of psi(u)/u. Default 0.

RlmResult#summary.en: Result of `rlm`: robust coefficients, fitted values, scale and convergence diagnostics.

RlmResult.converged#summary.en: Whether the estimating equations and scale iteration converged.

RlmResult.convergence#summary.en: Convergence diagnostics for the estimating equations and scale.

RlmResult.initialization#summary.en: Details of the deterministic high-breakdown initial estimate.

RlmResult.initialization.candidateCount#.en: Total number of candidate subsets, as a decimal string.

RlmResult.initialization.coefficients#su.en: Named coefficients from the initial estimate.

RlmResult.initialization.exhaustive#summ.en: Whether every candidate subset was evaluated.

RlmResult.initialization.method#summary.en: Initial estimator used before the M step.

RlmResult.initialization.objective#summa.en: Objective value of the selected initial estimate.

RlmResult.model#summary.en: Model data and settings retained for companion methods.

RlmResult.robustWeights#summary.en: Robust weights from the selected score function.

RlmResult.workingWeights#summary.en: Combined weights used in weighted least-squares steps.

RlmSummaryResult.values#summary.en: Rows of estimates, standard errors and test statistics.

RlmSummaryResult.warnings#summary.en: Warnings produced while computing the summary.

RlmVcovResult.columns#summary.en: Coefficient names in matrix column order.

RlmVcovResult.rows#summary.en: Coefficient names in matrix row order.

RlmVcovResult.warnings#summary.en: Warnings produced while computing the covariance.

nls#@param options.en: Starting values, algorithm, weights, and convergence controls.

nls#@returns.en: The fitted coefficients, residuals, covariance, and convergence diagnostics.

nls#summary.en:
Nonlinear least-squares regression. Equivalent to R's `nls()`.

Fits a user-specified nonlinear mean function by Gauss-Newton, variable projection, or bound-constrained
least squares. Formula expressions are parsed safely and differentiated symbolically.

nlsAnova#@param fits.en: Two or more nested fits to the same observations.

nlsAnova#summary.en: Analysis of variance for nested nonlinear least-squares fits. Equivalent to R's `anova.nls()`.

nlsConfint#@param options.en: Interval method, confidence level, and parameter names.

nlsConfint#summary.en: Wald or profile confidence intervals for nonlinear parameters. Equivalent to R's `confint.nls()`.

nlsPredict#@returns.en: One fitted mean per row of new data.

nlsPredict#summary.en: Predictions from a nonlinear least-squares fit. Equivalent to R's `predict.nls()`.

nlsSummary#@returns.en: The coefficient table, residual scale, and residual degrees of freedom.

nlsSummary#summary.en: Summary of a nonlinear least-squares fit. Equivalent to R's `summary.nls()`.

nlsVcov#@returns.en: The covariance matrix in coefficient order.

nlsVcov#summary.en: Covariance matrix of a nonlinear least-squares fit. Equivalent to R's `vcov.nls()`.

polr#@param data.en: The data frame: an object of columns.

polr#@param formula.en: A formula such as `"rating ~ treatment + age"`.

polr#@param options.en: The link, weights, offset, starts, contrasts and optimisation controls.

polr#@returns.en: The fitted slopes, cut-points, fitted probabilities and likelihood statistics.

polr#summary.en: Fit a cumulative-link ordinal regression. Equivalent to R's `MASS::polr()`.

polrAnova#@param fits.en: Two or more nested fits, ordered from the smallest to the largest model.

polrAnova#@returns.en: The sequential likelihood-ratio chi-squared comparison table.

polrConfint#@param options.en: The interval method, confidence level and selected slope parameters.

polrConfint#@returns.en: A table of lower and upper confidence limits; cut-points are not included.

polrPredict#@param options.en: New predictor columns, optional row labels, and the prediction type.

polrPredict#@returns.en: Predicted category labels, or a matrix with one probability column per response level.

polrPredict#summary.en: Predict ordinal categories or their probabilities for new observations. Equivalent to R's `predict.polr()`.

polrSummary#@returns.en: Estimates, standard errors and Wald t statistics.

polrSummary#summary.en: Summary table of the slope and cut-point estimates. Equivalent to R's `summary.polr()`.

polrVcov#@returns.en: The covariance matrix in slope-then-cut-point order.

polrVcov#summary.en: Covariance matrix of the slopes and cut-points. Equivalent to R's `vcov.polr()`.

psiBisquare#@returns.en: The IRLS weight psi(u)/u, or psi'(u) when deriv is 1.

psiBisquare#summary.en: Tukey's bisquare psi function. Equivalent to R's `MASS::psi.bisquare()`.

psiHampel#@param options.en: Three tuning points and output selection.

psiHampel#@returns.en: The IRLS weight psi(u)/u, or psi'(u) when deriv is 1.

psiHampel#summary.en: Hampel's three-part psi function. Equivalent to R's `MASS::psi.hampel()`.

psiHuber#@returns.en: The IRLS weight psi(u)/u, or psi'(u) when deriv is 1.

psiHuber#summary.en: Huber's psi function. Equivalent to R's `MASS::psi.huber()`.

rlm#@param formula.en: A formula such as `"y ~ x1 + x2"`.

rlm#@param options.en: Psi, scale, initial values, observation weights and iteration controls.

rlm#@returns.en: Coefficients, fitted values, residuals, robust weights, scale and covariance diagnostics.

rlm#summary.en: Robust M regression. Equivalent to R's `MASS::rlm()`.

rlmSummary#@returns.en: Coefficients, standard errors and t statistics.

rlmSummary#summary.en: Coefficient table of a robust fit. Equivalent to R's `summary.rlm()`.

rlmVcov#@returns.en: The covariance matrix in coefficient order.

rlmVcov#summary.en: Covariance matrix of robust-regression coefficients. Equivalent to R's `vcov.rlm()`.
